questions.prompt: In a double-slit light experiment, state why the two slits can act as coherent sources and name the pattern observed on the screen.
In λ = ax/D, which quantity is represented by x?

options.B: The separation of the two slits
options.C: The separation of adjacent bright fringes
options.D: The distance travelled by the light source
